title: Querying for `nil` polymorphic associations raises `ArgumentError`
body:
### Steps to reproduce

Following raises `ArgumentError: Polymorphic associations do not support computing the class.`:

```ruby
class Comment < ActiveRecord::Base
  belongs_to :resource, polymorphic: true, optional: true
end

Comment.where(resource: nil).size
# => ArgumentError: Polymorphic associations do not support computing the class.
```

It *works* on `<= 6.1.0` but *fails* on `6-1-stable` and `master`.

See https://gist.github.com/doits/ce889800623765b96b259adcd6cc9f66 for the test case.

**Edit**: Broken by https://github.com/rails/rails/pull/40815 / Offending commit https://github.com/rails/rails/pull/40815/commits/52b850a9b2bf1961c08c13f8790da4bbc11975da - reverting it makes the test pass

### System configuration
**Rails version**: `6-1-stable` and `master`

**Ruby version**: 2.7.2
